name: baseten
description: Hosted open models through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, plus System One decision models
long_description: Bring a Baseten API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists the Model APIs catalog (GET /v1/models), which bills no tokens. A Sprite can then call Baseten Model APIs (hosted language models such as GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek and gpt-oss) through OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages, and classify, route and score inputs with System One decision models. Every inference request bills tokens to your Baseten workspace. Only the shared Model APIs host inference.baseten.co is reachable: the management API (api.baseten.co: API keys, billing, usage, teams, models and deployments) and dedicated model deployments are not forwarded.

presentation.tagline: Call Baseten's hosted language and decision models from a Sprite without putting your Baseten key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at app.baseten.co, open Organization settings → API keys and choose Create API key. Prefer a team key with the Invoke Model APIs permission, scoped to the Model APIs the Sprite needs; personal keys carry all of your permissions, must expire within 90 days and are revoked after 30 days without use.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key lists models with `GET /v1/models` and bills nothing. Chat Completions, Responses, Messages and System One requests bill input and output tokens at each model's per-million-token price; cached input tokens are discounted, Fast model variants have their own prices, System One's `flex` tier costs about 90% of the default price and `priority` about 2x, and server-side web search passes the search provider's cost through. If your workspace enforces a monthly budget, Baseten rejects Model API requests once it is reached.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/responses`, `POST /v1/messages` and `POST /v1/systemone` on `inference.baseten.co` are forwarded. The management API (API keys, billing, usage and costs, teams, models and deployments), dedicated deployment hosts and the regional `inference-eu` host are not. Rate limits are per model and per workspace (by default 15 to 120 requests a minute depending on account tier).

usage_notes: The gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers and Model APIs have no request timeout parameter. For long generations or reasoning-heavy models, send `stream: true` so headers arrive at once, and cap `max_tokens`.
Send `x-session-affinity` with a stable id on related requests to improve prompt cache reuse; it is the one request header forwarded.
Error bodies are JSON with an `error` message (System One adds `error_type`). A streamed response can end early without an error status; check the final event and `finish_reason`.
